title.narrative: Bringing Agenda 2030 to life: Strengthening the role of the Church and voices from the ground

description.narrative:
Transforming Our World; The 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development is the result of many years of collective thinking across the international community about the priorities and process of international development. It results in an ambitious agenda with an aspirational preamble and declaration, as well as 17 specific goals (the Sustainable Development Goals or SDGs) and 169 targets.
This project seeks to refocus the development debate at local and national level on this transformation approach – bringing a clear values-based voice from the Church and authentic experience from the ground; and visualize what these shifts look like in practice through specific examples of where there are projects, programmes and policies that represent this approach.
This project will strengthen national level advocacy by CAFOD partners (particularly the church) and wider coalition to support the transformation shifts of Agenda 2030 by bringing voices from a wide range of stakeholders, including communities. It will also help influence the UN guidance to states on implementing Agenda 2030 to emphasis the transformation shifts of leave no one behind, environmental sustainability; participation and tackling inequality.
